analysis.scope: Hook and utility duplication patterns in React hooks (11 files) and helper utilities (5 files)

instances.code: const rafRef = useRef<number | null>(null); ... requestAnimationFrame() + return cleanup
const rafId = useRef<number | null>(null); ... requestAnimationFrame() + return cleanup

critical_duplication.pattern: Both hooks manage requestAnimationFrame with a ref and cleanup. Could extract shared RAF handler utility.
critical_duplication.recommendation: Create src/utils/raf-manager.ts with reusable RAF management logic

critical_duplication.pattern: Reduced motion media query is duplicated. useReducedMotion is a hook, but scroll.ts reimplements the check.
critical_duplication.recommendation: Export reduced motion check from useReducedMotion or create shared utility; scroll.ts should import from useReducedMotion hook or create helper

critical_duplication.pattern: All three mouse-tracking hooks manage addEventListener/removeEventListener independently. No shared pattern.
critical_duplication.recommendation: Create useWindowEventListener hook that handles setup/cleanup boilerplate

instances.code: useState initializer reads localStorage, guarded by typeof window check
useState initializer with multiple typeof window guards + storage/window checks

critical_duplication.pattern: All hooks that use storage repeat: (1) typeof window check, (2) localStorage access pattern, (3) error handling.
critical_duplication.recommendation: Create useLocalStorage hook that handles SSR guards and error handling automatically

critical_duplication.pattern: Both music hooks implement identical async fetch pattern: loading state, error handling, finally cleanup.
critical_duplication.recommendation: Extract useFetch or useAsyncData hook to consolidate (loading, error, retry logic)

instances.code: const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000); const minutesAgo = Math.floor((now - parseInt(timestamp)) / 60);

moderate_duplication.pattern: Date/time operations scattered. No shared time utility.
moderate_duplication.recommendation: Create src/utils/time-utils.ts with: formatTimestampDelta, getMinutesAgo, etc.

instances.code: const mouseX = useMotionValue(0); const mouseY = useMotionValue(0); ... set()
const mouseX = useMotionValue(0); const mouseY = useMotionValue(0); ... set()

moderate_duplication.pattern: Both create identical Framer Motion motion values for mouse tracking. useSpotlight is simpler (just position), useMousePositionMotion is global.
moderate_duplication.recommendation: useSpotlight could leverage useMousePositionMotion or extract shared motion-value initialization pattern

moderate_duplication.pattern: Multiple hooks implement setInterval polling with identical cleanup pattern.
moderate_duplication.recommendation: Create useInterval hook that abstracts interval creation, dependencies, and cleanup

moderate_duplication.pattern: Accumulating arrays with optional trimming. F1 telemetry trims to last 4 items; terminal doesn't.
moderate_duplication.recommendation: Create useAccumulatingState hook with optional maxLength parameter

validation_utilities.note: Project does NOT have is-boolean.ts, is-external.ts as listed in input. These files do not exist in codebase.

string_transformation.purpose: Extract numeric value and suffix from string like '80%' → {num: 80, suffix: '%'}
Normalize artist field (can be string or object)

string_transformation.note: No dedicated string utilities. No capitalize, format-duration, get-years files found (input listed non-existent files)

instances.pattern: Multiple storage keys: terminal_booted, window.__TERMINAL_BOOTED__, sessionStorage
Token, expiry, state, verifier (4 keys, complex lifecycle)

storage_persistence.recommendation: Create useLocalStorage<T>(key, initialValue, options) hook with JSON serialization, SSR safety, and error handling

hook_dependencies.pattern: Good separation: terminal logic, routing, scroll fx

hook_dependencies.note: Tightly coupled to data shape; could be more reusable

key_extraction_candidates.name: useLocalStorage
key_extraction_candidates.benefit: Consolidate 3 different storage patterns, add SSR safety, JSON serialization

key_extraction_candidates.name: useFetch
key_extraction_candidates.benefit: Unify useLastFm + useSpotify fetch + loading + error pattern

key_extraction_candidates.name: useMotionTracker
key_extraction_candidates.benefit: Share Framer Motion motion value + mousemove handler between useMousePositionMotion and useSpotlight

data_integrity_issues.issue: Ternary operator chain has syntax error: '90  -' should be '90 ?' and missing colon before last case
Invalid switch case: 'case 'Spa' -' should be 'case 'Spa':', dashes used instead of colons
Parameter destructuring syntax error: 'cmd - string' should be 'cmd: string'
Invalid ternary: 'prev === -1 ? 0  - prev' should be 'prev === -1 ? 0 : prev'
Parameter destructuring syntax error: '(key - string)' should be '(key: string)'

code_quality_notes: Multiple files have dash/minus signs where colons should be (likely copy-paste corruption)
useF1Telemetry is very large (240 lines) and manages ~15 state variables; candidate for refactoring into smaller sub-hooks
useTerminalSession is also large (150 lines); command resolution logic could be extracted
No shared raf-manager utility despite two hooks using identical RAF + ref + cleanup pattern
